questions.question: Which step in the SEM methodology involves optimizing the detection of backscattered electrons to provide compositional contrast in an image?
What is the primary purpose of the Through-Lens Detection (TLD) mode in SEM?

answers.a: To detect phase distributions and compositional variations
answers.b: To enhance detection efficiency and reduce noise in imaging
answers.c: To analyze crystallographic orientation through diffraction patterns
answers.d: To perform elemental mapping and compositional analysis

questions.question: In SEM, why is backscattered electron (BSE) imaging particularly useful for compositional contrast?

answers.a: It is sensitive to surface roughness only
answers.b: It provides contrast based on differences in atomic number
answers.c: It enhances edge effects for topographical imaging
answers.d: It detects secondary electrons emitted from the surface

questions.question: Which SEM imaging mode is best suited for improving signal collection efficiency at low working distances?
What is the main advantage of performing multiple elemental mapping using EDS in SEM?

answers.a: It increases magnification without changing resolution
answers.b: It allows simultaneous visualization of spatial distribution of different elements
answers.d: It reduces charging effects in non-conductive samples
